title: amount written out in Spanish
text: El importe es doscientos euros más IVA.
why: Prose numbers are not detected. This is listed under Limits in the README.

title: amount written out in English
text: The fee is twenty euros per month.

title: date written out in Spanish
text: Nos vemos el tres de marzo en la oficina.
why: Dates need digits. A day spelled out as a word is not parsed.

title: date written out in English
why: Ordinal words are not parsed as days.

title: relative date
why: A relative date carries no number to shift and holds no calendar fact.

title: phone number in words
text: Mi número es seis cero cero uno dos tres cuatro cinco seis.
why: Digits spelled as words are not detected.
